question:
Re-check these netdisk-pan records against their first-party pages: confirm what still holds, set the fields that changed, and record a dead host as dead with the evidence. Use one `confirm` per evidence row and name only the fields that row's quote proves; list every field you did not re-read in `unread`. Set a field only when the new page states a different value.
An audit of the first attempt judged these claims unsupported by their sources; settle each one first:
- netdisk-pan/kuhehe-alist-index $.notes: Commit dates and count (36) are supported, but 144 hosts, 126 hosts, 11 survivors, 8.7%, 9.0 and 8.9 month half-lives are not in the capture; the 3月23日 section is in another capture.
- netdisk-pan/tab-digital-nextcloud $.free_tier.unit: Page says 8GB / 8 GB, not GiB; unit differs.
- netdisk-pan/nextfiles-one $.retention.days: Page states the last 7 days of backups; retention.days null contradicts it.
- netdisk-pan/alistshare-telegram $.free_tier.stated: Channel text and public_dav user are present, but no 2026-11-19 date appears in the original or my fresh capture (sha256:0cef6d80...), which show only times.
- netdisk-pan/bangumi-alist-index $.chaining: Quote only says AList was sold and OpenList is recommended; "highest-yield discovery input measured in this wave" and churn-hiding are not in the source.
- netdisk-pan/kuhehe-alist-index $.retention.stated: Capture shows 3月23日 as a section header at the top and also an entry 8月13日新增网盘 further down, so "newest section is 23 March" is not shown; 2025-06-17 commit is in another capture; "stopped tracking" is inference.
- netdisk-pan/bangumi-alist-index $.notes: Counts 31, 3, 28, 26, 20 are not in the capture; quote does not support them.
- netdisk-pan/tab-digital-nextcloud $.extras.free_tier_survives_repricing: Page says prices for new upgrades rise from July 1, 2026; it does not state that the free 8 GB account survives.
- netdisk-pan/tab-digital-nextcloud $.free_tier.stated: Free 8GB and 128GB 7,44 EUR are supported, but the cited capture has no business price; in the pricing capture 1TB is Business and up to 100TB is Enterprise (contact sales), so "business ... 1 TB to 100 TB" is wrong.
- netdisk-pan/nextfiles-one $.free_tier.unit: Page offers a 1-month trial, not a free tier, and says TB not TiB.
- netdisk-pan/nextfiles-one $.free_tier.metered_on: Trial is not a free tier; page states no metering basis for it.
- netdisk-pan/nextfiles-one $.identity_cost.detail: Page lists payment options, but nothing says the trial needs no card.
- netdisk-pan/crt-sh-alist-openlist-ct-channel $.free_tier.stated: Page is only a search form; "JSON output" is not in the capture.
